run_optical_flow_generation: run the script to generate forward and backward optical flow for an image sequence using RAFT
load_image_for_flow: create a function that loads an image, resizes it to 768px long dimension, and returns a CUDA tensor
resize_flow_tensor: build a function that resizes an optical flow field to match target image dimensions with proper scaling
